title: Svenska Kraftnät NUP — transmission cross-section (snitt) capacity target
description: One record per directional transmission cross-section in the Swedish grid. Captures current allocated trade capacity and Svenska Kraftnät's target levels for 2030/2035/2040/2045 per Tabell 3 in NUP §4.2. The 'snitt' concept partitions the grid where bottlenecks limit transfer between bidding zones; targets here drive Pillar 1 (existing transmission baseline) and Pillar 2 (transmission development over time) at the highest aggregation level. Used as one input to the buildability gate at the bidding-zone scope.

snitt_key.description: Stable snake_case key. Format: <from_zone_lower>_to_<to_zone_lower>. Example: se1_to_se2.

current_capacity_mw.description: Maximum allocated trade capacity in MW for the most recent reported period.

targets.description: Capacity targets at future milestones. Source NUP §4.2 reports for 2030, 2035, 2040, 2045.

narrative_note.description: Free-text English narrative for context (which Svk programs drive these targets, e.g. 'NordSyd reinforces snitt 2').
